page.content:
Realm of the dead ruled by Hades and Persephone.

How Underworld connects

  • Character: Hades — Hades is lord of the Underworld.
  • Topic: Greek mythology — The Underworld is the land of the dead in Greek myth.
  • Character: Cerberus — Cerberus guards the gates of the Underworld.
  • Location: Tartarus — Tartarus lies beneath the halls of the dead.
  • Character: Hermes — Hermes guides shades into the house of Hades.
  • Character: Odysseus — Odysseus consults the dead in the Nekyia of the Odyssey.
  • Character: Theseus — Theseus descended living into Hades and was bound there.

What is Underworld?

The Underworld is the land of the dead: the house of Hades, the fields of asphodel, and the gates guarded by Cerberus. Mortals descend only as shades unless a hero forces a living entry.

Key threads lead to Hades, Greek mythology, Cerberus, Tartarus, Hermes and Odysseus.
